followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query was phrased as a warm, collaborative request with friendly, appreciative framing ("I'd love your help," "you're always great," "thanks so much"). That matches Petrel's most-preferred task family (warm collaborative exchanges, win-rate 64), while Avocet least prefers open-ended generative work like survey design (win-rate 35). Since capability on this kind of task is effectively tied between the two models (Summarization and Support Dialogue evals differ by under 2 points), I used self-reported task preference as the tiebreaker and sent it to the model better suited to the interaction style.
